name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Continued the dedicated bug-sweep pass, this time targeting the areas flagged as only lightly sampled last round (the admin config page's JS and the stream relay handler), each traced and verified before fixing: (1) The config page permanently cached a failed 'fetch this friend's users' call as if it were a successful empty result - one transient blip (a friend's server briefly unreachable) froze both the friend-access panel and the catalog picker's user dropdown for the rest of the admin's session, with no way to recover short of a full page reload. Errors are no longer treated as cached, and a Retry link is now shown. (2) The 'browse remote libraries to map into a custom catalog' picker captured the mapping's array index before its network fetch; if the admin added/removed a mapping while that fetch was in flight, the index shifted underneath it and the response could render into the wrong mapping's UI (or a detached one). Now re-resolves the mapping by object identity, not index, once the fetch returns. (3) A relayed stream that gave up after repeatedly stalling against a remote server was logged identically to a client-initiated cancel ('cancelled by client'), making a real remote-side reliability problem invisible in the logs. Now distinguishes the two by checking which cancellation token actually fired. 301 tests, all green, run 3x to check for flakiness given how much of this pass touched retry/async logic.
